title: Adjoint root compiler and chamber-Steiner intertwiner
purpose: Certify the ten-trit transvection-root compiler with its chirality and symmetry-loss boundaries, then construct the exact rational rank-24 intertwiner between the chamber and Steiner fiber-constant carriers.
boundary: Pass4938 is an exact finite characteristic-three compiler and symmetry-firewall theorem, not a hardware, security, or continuum theorem. Pass4939 identifies only the rational rank-24 Steiner fiber-constant sector with the chamber line lane; it does not identify the point and line carriers, touch the transverse 20+60 sector, or construct a physical state transfer.
